data.one_liner: Fast, zero-dependency Dart and Flutter dead code, assets, and packages remediation engine.
data.what_it_does: Scans Dart and Flutter projects to safely detect and clean dead classes, unused widgets, commented-out code blocks, unused imports, TODO tasks, unreferenced media assets, and unused external packages. Provides both a terminal control dashboard and a programmatic or CI/CD audit report.
use_when: You want to clean up technical debt and remove dead code, unused classes, or orphaned assets in medium to large projects.
You need an automated static analysis tool that goes beyond standard dart analyze to catch unused public widgets and models.
avoid_when: You are looking for a package to handle state management, routing, or general app architecture.
Your project is extremely small and has no need for automated code remediation.
strengths: Zero external dependencies and fast AST-based analysis.
Interactive terminal dashboard (TUI) with dry-run previews and instant rollback.
Covers 13 code quality points including commented files, dead classes, assets, and dependencies.
weaknesses: Can require careful configuration via pubspec.yaml exclusions for generated files or dynamic assets to avoid false positives.
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml or activate globally using dart pub global activate detect_unused_code.
